_what: Canonical RadioAnatome anatomy registry. GENERATED by ontology.py from atlas/*/atlas.json plus atlas-pipeline/labels/*.json. Do not hand-edit: run `python ontology.py --write`.
_laterality: NONE_ASSERTED is the default and is correct for every Visible Human structure: no side is claimed anywhere in this atlas because two landmarks disagree on this cadaver. Living-patient sources may assert a side.
_confidence: GOOD = mask passed HU and position checks and has pins in a shipped module. NOT_AVAILABLE = the structure is declared but has no geometry, which is deliberate and must stay visible.

VENTRAL_DIENCEPHALON.definition: NOT a single named structure and NOT a Terminologia Anatomica term: this is the FreeSurfer "ventral diencephalon" segmentation label, a composite of the grey and white matter packed between the thalamus above, the internal capsule laterally and the midbrain below. It contains the hypothalamus, mammillary body and subthalamic nucleus (diencephalic), the geniculate bodies (metathalamic), the substantia nigra and red nucleus (which are MIDBRAIN, not diencephalon), the zona incerta, and fibre bundles including the medial lemniscus and lenticular fasciculus. It is shown as an aggregate because this segmentation cannot separate them: do not learn any one of these structures from this pin.

bp3d.note: SynthSeg's composite 'ventral DC' has no FMA equivalent; hypothalamus + diencephalon parts are shown.
